reason: We have to replace lost volume, and this is the first agency offer where I pay for meetings, not slides. Three free meetings, bad ones marked free, EUR 900 cap: I'll do the free 15-company list and, if it looks like people I actually want, run the pilot.
objection: One unnamed logistics client with 45 meetings is not proof. I've heard this before, so I expect a fight over what counts as a 'qualified' meeting, and I expect 'meetings' with juniors who will never send a tender. And Apollo plus a junior SDR would still be mine after 45 days.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 companies in the free list are names I already know or obvious ones from a directory, I walk away. A reference call with that logistics client would make me commit faster.
